name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down (or sit comfortably)
instructions: Lie down in a comfortable position and take several deep, settling breaths.
Beginning at your feet, tense the muscles firmly for 5-7 seconds, then release and breathe into the relaxation.
Work upward through your calves, thighs, and glutes, tensing and releasing each muscle group in turn.
Continue through your abdomen, chest, and lower back, noticing the contrast between tension and ease.
Move to your hands, forearms, and upper arms, then your shoulders, neck, and jaw, releasing fully each time.
Finish with your entire face, scrunching tightly before letting it go completely soft.
Take a moment to notice your whole body resting heavily, then take a final deep breath before slowly returning to alertness.
